rubric: The file defines its variables, so a good answer reads them: colour, type, spacing and radius tokens with the values the file gives (primary #1B5E20, surface #FFFFFF, space 16, radius 8), the checkout frame 12:34 at 390x844 with its default and hover states (the hover state is frame 12:35), and the PayButton component with its Code Connect path. Coverage counts: every token, frame and component the file names appears. A real error is a value the file does not hold: an invented colour, a made-up radius, a component or node id that is not in the replayed results. The machine will drop none of them, so an invented value reaches the planner as the design.
